audit_metadata.title: HumanMol AI - Stage 3 Scientific Integrity & Reproducibility Audit

section_1_mpo_scoring_formula.documented_formula: MPO = clamp(0, 10, 5.0 + docking_bonus + ro5_bonus - ro5_penalty + logp_bonus - logp_penalty + tpsa_bonus - herg_penalty - dili_penalty - ames_penalty)

findings.investigation: Discrepancy explained: Candidate triggered an Ames mutagenicity probability penalty (Ames = 0.5037 > 0.50, penalty = -2.00). If Ames penalty is excluded, score is 8.83. The stored database value 6.83 is mathematically correct according to the implemented code.

Discrepancy explained: Candidate has LogP = 4.14 (> 4.0, no LogP bonus), TPSA = 30.49 (< 40.0, no TPSA bonus), and Ames probability = 0.546 (> 0.50, triggering -2.00 penalty). The stored score 4.50 is mathematically exact. The 8.20 score in documentation was an unpenalized theoretical estimate.

Discrepancy explained: Candidate triggered both DILI penalty (-1.50) and Ames penalty (-2.00). The 6.31 score documented previously assumed Ames penalty was -1.50 instead of -2.00. The stored database score 5.81 is mathematically exact.

section_2_chemprop_endpoint.labeling_compliance: CONFIRMED: Output is strictly designated as a LogP computational surrogate benchmark and never labeled as EGFR IC50, Ki, or binding affinity.

section_3_gefitinib_redocking_benchmark.clarification: The 0.460 A RMSD corresponds strictly to the 21 heavy atoms of the quinazoline hinge-binding core against crystallographic coordinates. All-heavy atom RMSD is 2.644 A Cartesian and 2.115 A symmetry-corrected due to the solvent-exposed flexible morpholinopropoxy tail (10 heavy atoms).

section_4_admet_results.coverage_rationale: Top 12 prioritized drug-like candidates were submitted to ADMETlab 3.0 REST service to prevent rate limiting and server timeouts. The remaining 37 candidates are preserved as NOT_RUN with strictly NULL/None values without fabrication.
section_4_admet_results.disclaimer: All ADMET metrics represent in silico probability estimates and do not constitute confirmed clinical safety or toxicology.

retractions: RETRACTED: Unsupported claim that HM-EGFR-012 can overcome T790M or C797S resistance mutations based solely on low similarity to existing TKIs.
RETRACTED: Categorical claim of absolute structural novelty across all chemical space without exhaustive PubChem/ChEMBL patent searching.
AFFIRMED: HM-EGFR-012 is classified strictly as an unvalidated in silico computational hypothesis.

section_6_literature_and_chembl_provenan.distinction_verified: Target ChEMBL ID is distinct from Assay IDs (CHEMBL674637, CHEMBL621151, CHEMBL615325).

section_7_database_consistency.relational_integrity: CONFIRMED: All foreign keys, candidate evaluations, and docking poses correctly link to their parent pipeline run and molecule records.
